overrides.value: A starting template for building Zotero plugins: TypeScript with Zotero type definitions, API usage examples, auto hot reload, automated build and GitHub release, and Prettier and ESLint setup.
overrides.reason: Condensed from the Features list of README.md. The manifest description only repeats the name, and the GitHub About text, "A plugin template for Zotero.", only repeats it too.
